newsitem.title: INDIA: Pre-monsoon smuggling weakens Indian gold.
newsitem.headline: Pre-monsoon smuggling weakens Indian gold.

text.p: ** Gold 24 carat closed 15 rupees lower at 4,740 rupees per 10 gramme against Monday's close as an influx of smuggled metal hit the market. Smugglers shipping gold by sea have stepped up operations before the monsoon arrives to beat the bad weather. Gold fell 15 rupees on Monday.
** Gold biscuit (116.50 gramme) closed 150 rupees lower at 55,400 rupees after losing 150 rupees on Monday.
** Silver (.999) closed 10 rupees higher at 6,840 rupees per kg against the previous close of 6,830 rupees on the back of uptrend in the world market while local buying remained at a low ebb.
